name: lauterbrunnen
title: Lauterbrunnen Valley, Bernese Oberland, Switzerland
note: A glacial trough: a flat floor about 800 m up between limestone walls 300-500 m sheer, the hanging terraces of Wengen and Muerren above them.
grid: local azimuthal equidistant (sphere R=6371008.8 m) centred on centre_lat/centre_lon; x east, y north; row 0 = north edge; pixel centre x = (col + 0.5 - cols/2) * pixel_size_m, y = (rows/2 - row - 0.5) * pixel_size_m

source.dataset: swissALTI3D, 2 m tiles (1 km x 1 km), latest edition per tile
source.licence: swisstopo free geodata (Open Government Data): free use, the source must be cited; https://www.swisstopo.admin.ch/en/terms-of-use-free-geodata-and-geoservices
source.resampling: Gaussian low-pass (sigma 1.80 source px) then bilinear

licence: swisstopo free geodata (Open Government Data): free use, the source must be cited; https://www.swisstopo.admin.ch/en/terms-of-use-free-geodata-and-geoservices
encoding: 16-bit greyscale PNG: height_m = height_min_m + v / 65535 * (height_max_m - height_min_m)
